# Together

> Together helps two adults already in the same public place discover that the interest is mutual, then meet face to face. The meeting is the outcome; profiles, likes and messages are not. Starting in London, with a launch list open now.

## Pages

- [Together](https://together.hyperdrift.io/): how it works and the London launch list
- [Together, en français](https://together.hyperdrift.io/fr): the same page in French
- [The Together proposal](https://together.hyperdrift.io/proposal): the case for a more human way to meet
- [Privacy](https://together.hyperdrift.io/privacy): what is collected and why
